pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark-pigmented regions with varied edge angularity. Pixel gradients at boundaries are moderately defined but subject to image blur. Patch size is heterogeneous, with larger, vertically elongated shapes on the upper neck and smaller, more compact shapes on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological graph. A clear vertex/junction node is visible on the mid-flank where five corridor segments intersect. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the central torso, roughly 1/8th the width of adjacent patches.
